name: Maoujou Re:build!
source:
A year has passed since the Demon King Gibeon, the embodiment of tyranny, was defeated by the Six Heroes.

King Gortain, one of the Six Heroes, saw the surviving demons and numerous demi-humans as a threat and suppressed them through cruel persecution and discrimination.
The Demon King's daughter Lapis, the last survivor of the royal lineage, visits a man living in the royal capital outskirts together with her maidservant Kalmia with the intention of restoring the now-ruined demon capital Margurd. 

The shopkeeper of a run-down fruit store Shigure has another side to him; A "fixer" who will take on any and all commissions provided the price is right.

"Lend me your strength and help me gather the seven Mara Crystals!".

The desires of the demon King's orphaned scion and the ninja from distant lands entwine with each other.

And thus, the rebuild of the demon king's castle at the hands of Lapis and Shigure begins. 

[Translated from official website]
translation:
暴虐化身的魔王基遍被六勇者打倒，已经过去一年了。

六英雄之一的戈坦国王将幸存的恶魔和众多的亚人视为威胁，并通过残酷的迫害和歧视来镇压他们。
魔王之女拉碧丝是王族最后的幸存者，她与女仆卡尔米娅一起拜访了居住在王都郊区的一名男子，目的是恢复已被毁坏的魔都玛格德。

破败水果店时雨的店主也有另一面。只要价格合适，“中间人”就会承担所有佣金。

“借给我你的力量，帮我收集七颗玛拉水晶！”。

魔王的孤儿和来自远方的忍者的欲望相互交织。

就这样，拉碧丝和时雨手中的魔王城的重建开始了。
